title: Administrative Assistant
source_jd_text:
Administrative Assistant, Operations Team (fictional company: Harrow & Vale Property Services)

About the role
We are looking for an Administrative Assistant to keep a busy 15-person operations team organised. You will be the first point of contact for the office and make sure meetings, documents and records run smoothly.

What you will do
- Manage calendars for three managers, schedule meetings and book rooms, travel and accommodation.
- Answer the main phone line and the shared inbox, and direct enquiries to the right person.
- Prepare letters, reports and presentations in Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint (or Google Workspace).
- Keep digital and paper records accurate and up to date, including contracts and supplier files.
- Process purchase orders, invoices and expense claims and track them in a spreadsheet.
- Take minutes at weekly team meetings and follow up on action points.
- Order office supplies and coordinate with building maintenance.

What we are looking for
- At least two years of experience in an administrative, office or reception role.
- Strong organisation skills and attention to detail.
- Confident with Microsoft Office or Google Workspace, especially Excel.
- Clear written and spoken English.
- You must be able to work in our office four days a week.

Nice to have
- Experience with a project or task tool such as Asana or Trello.
- Experience supporting a property, facilities or real-estate business.
- A recognised administrative or office-management qualification.

What we offer
Hybrid working (one day from home), 25 days of annual leave, a training budget and a friendly team.

criteria.name: Calendar and Travel Management
criteria.description: Experience managing multiple managers' calendars, coordinating meetings, booking rooms, and arranging travel and accommodation.

anchors.0: No evidence of calendar management, meeting scheduling, or travel booking.
anchors.1: Brief mention of scheduling meetings or booking travel without context on volume or complexity.
anchors.2: Some evidence of coordinating diaries and making standard travel or room bookings for colleagues.
anchors.3: Clear evidence of managing calendars for multiple managers, scheduling complex meetings, and booking detailed travel and accommodation.
anchors.4: Sustained, specific evidence of proactively coordinating multi-manager schedules, resolving diary conflicts, and organizing seamless end-to-end travel itineraries.

criteria.jd_quote: Manage calendars for three managers, schedule meetings and book rooms, travel and accommodation.

criteria.name: Office Software Proficiency (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
criteria.description: Proficiency using office productivity software (Microsoft Office or Google Workspace) to prepare documents, presentations, and track data in spreadsheets.

anchors.0: No evidence of using Microsoft Office or Google Workspace applications.
anchors.1: Mentions Microsoft Office or Google Workspace as a list of skills without practical application details.
anchors.2: Some evidence of drafting documents, preparing basic presentations, or entering data into spreadsheets.
anchors.3: Clear evidence of preparing polished reports, presentations, and utilizing Excel or Google Sheets for structured data tracking and analysis.
anchors.4: Sustained, specific evidence of advanced document formatting, dynamic presentations, and strong spreadsheet expertise including formulas, data tracking, or pivot tables.

criteria.jd_quote: Confident with Microsoft Office or Google Workspace, especially Excel.

criteria.name: Financial Administration and Invoicing
criteria.description: Experience handling financial admin tasks, including processing purchase orders, invoices, and expense claims, and tracking them in spreadsheets.

anchors.0: No evidence of financial administration, invoicing, or expense handling.
anchors.1: Vague mention of dealing with receipts, bills, or invoices.
anchors.2: Some evidence of processing invoices, raising purchase orders, or logging basic expenses.
anchors.3: Clear, sustained evidence of regularly processing purchase orders, reconciling invoices, handling expense claims, and tracking figures in spreadsheets.
anchors.4: Sustained, measurable evidence of managing end-to-end invoice processing workflows, tracking expenditure spreadsheets with high accuracy, and resolving billing discrepancies.

criteria.jd_quote: Process purchase orders, invoices and expense claims and track them in a spreadsheet.

criteria.name: Record Keeping and Minute Taking
criteria.description: Experience maintaining accurate digital and paper records, contract files, taking structured meeting minutes, and tracking action points.

anchors.0: No evidence of maintaining records, managing files, or taking meeting minutes.
anchors.1: Brief mention of filing paperwork or taking general notes during meetings.
anchors.2: Some evidence of organizing digital or paper records and drafting meeting notes.
anchors.3: Clear evidence of systematically keeping digital and paper files (such as contracts and supplier files) up to date, taking formal meeting minutes, and tracking action items.
anchors.4: Sustained, specific evidence of establishing or maintaining rigorous document management systems, managing sensitive records, and delivering clear minutes with disciplined action point follow-through.

criteria.jd_quote: Keep digital and paper records accurate and up to date, including contracts and supplier files.

criteria.name: Office Coordination and Enquiries Management
criteria.description: Handling front-of-house communications, managing phone lines and shared inboxes, ordering office supplies, and liaising with facilities or maintenance.

anchors.0: No evidence of managing office communications, shared inboxes, or supplies.
anchors.1: Brief or vague mention of answering phones or assisting around the office.
anchors.2: Some evidence of handling incoming phone calls, responding to general emails, and ordering supplies.
anchors.3: Clear evidence of serving as an office contact point, triaging shared inboxes and phone calls, ordering supplies, and coordinating with maintenance contractors.
anchors.4: Sustained, specific evidence of efficiently managing high-volume enquiries, maintaining smooth office operations, and building reliable relationships with building facilities and external suppliers.

criteria.jd_quote: Answer the main phone line and the shared inbox, and direct enquiries to the right person.
